method.order: Emerald Metal AB/BA/AB; FireRed Metal AB/BA; FireRed OpenGL AB/BA/AB
method.simulation: one 1/60 second game/audio update per rendered frame; native terrain clock remains wall time; uncapped vsync0 with normal1ms loop sleep
method.npcSetup: Seed both RNGs, sort returned neighbor placements before construction and clear only test NPC pool for both games; no measured NPC update/draw patches. Canonical signatures include identities/sprites/coordinates/timers/ghost offsets; stack signatures match.
method.summary: Median of trial means, each equally averages two real maps at the same actual pixel size; tail summaries average scene P99s, not pooled P99.
method.CPU: CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID measures main Lua/graphics thread separately from process CPU, which includes workers. Wall timers measure queuing/native waits, not GPU timestamps or displayed FPS.
method.allocationProbe: AFTER every timed phase and OS proof: new decoder on actual source, 128 warm ticks then 120 allocation samples with GC stopped. CPU function microbenchmark uses automatic GC and its own separate allocation intervals.
method.sourceProvenance: Ten Metal cases use exact baseline/candidate sampler modules before later GL bridge-only fix; ordinary Metal frames never call that presenter. Both completed GL variants receive the same bridge fix. Final-source Metal window tests and all four GPU oracles use all final source modules.

functionMicrobenchmark.method: Actual resident Emerald banks; same process old/new methods AB/BA; main thread CPU; 2000 calls per block after128warmup; GC enabled during CPU timing, stopped only for separate128call allocation probes; not gameplay FPS

baselineProfile.method: LuaJIT sampling plus threadCPU/wall wrappers; instrumented and not a speedup comparison

rejectedSameProcessSceneDiagnostic.reason: Ordered NPC signature check failed: two dynamic entry actors appended in different order. Preserved separately; no causal scene-throughput conclusion from this pilot. Final acceptance uses canonical signatures including identities and sprites.

incompleteCases.reason: Inherited LuaJIT CType table overflow at ffi.cast in MacWindowSurface.arg during fourth scene. Three proof phases completed, original case/artifacts retained; entire case rerun with bound ABI functions in both variants.

limits: One nondedicated host, no control of protected player or other external load.
Static FireRed path unchanged and no sample cache created, but total timing noise remains; no unconditional performance parity/FPS claim.
